item.title: K of C Sells Wharf Tower For $14M

item.title: Schools Budget Q: To Ask For $232M Or $252M?
item.description: As New Haven Public Schools (NHPS) prepares its next budget, district leaders are debating whether to ask for the full cost of adequately staffing schools with counselors, teachers, security guards and new academic programs, or instead tailoring their request to what city and state officials have historically been willing to fund. The post Schools Budget Q: To Ask For $232M Or $252M? appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: DeLauro Eyes ICE Reform, Not Abolition
item.description: U.S. Rep. Rosa DeLauro emphasized her support on Friday for imposing “serious constraints” on Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) — and pushed back on calls from some local faith leaders to get rid of the agency altogether. The post DeLauro Eyes ICE Reform, Not Abolition appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Cold Couldn’t Stop Refugee Run
item.description: Eight-degree weather and below-zero windchill had nothing on New Haveners determined to support immigrants and refugees on Sunday morning. Nearly 1,800 people braved the cold to walk or run Integrated Refugee and Immigrant Services (IRIS)’ annual 5K “Run for Refugees” fundraiser in East Rock. Together, they raised over $100,000 for the organization. The post Cold Couldn’t Stop Refugee Run appeared first on New Haven Independent.
